summary: Verified owner-only 'Reset business data' feature end-to-end in PREVIEW. 4/4 backend pytest tests passed and both frontend UI role-gate checks passed. Non-owner POST /api/auth/admin/reset-business-data -> 403. Owner with confirm='reset' -> 400. Owner reset with confirm='RESET', include_leads=false wipes users (only owner remains), payment_transactions, subscriptions, gen_jobs, agent_jobs, agent_chats, war_room, war_room_meetings, team_memos, team_tasks, and templates of removed users; owner templates count, market_listings count, blog_posts count and leads count all unchanged. Owner /api/auth/me still 200 after reset (session survives). Titan chat response contains no '$80' or '6 users'. UI: owner /billing shows [data-testid=danger-zone] + [data-testid=reset-business-btn]; freshly registered non-owner /billing does NOT show either.
critical_code_review_comments: reset_business_data only deletes user_sessions for non-owner users but leaves owner's session tokens intact -> good, owner stays logged in. Fine as implemented.
leads collection is optionally cleared via include_leads flag; the danger-zone UI uses window.confirm (OK=clear leads) which is correctly wired. No issues.
rate_events and login_attempts are wiped unconditionally — could theoretically reset brute-force lockout state, but low risk since owner is the only surviving user.
